summary: The scalar estimates, nonsymmetric conditional-noise variance bound, closed-cap bound, independent-block composition, vector halfspace consumer, and likelihood attenuation consumer are valid as stated. The positive-tail estimates give exactly the constants 512K_W^2 and 2048K_N^2 used in the variance calculation. Conditional centering makes the center-noise covariance zero, and independence of full block experiments justifies the conditional product law and fourth-moment expansions with K_W,K_N at least 3. Direction-dependent representations are used only after fixing each direction, and the resulting sum has the original product law. Zero-variance cases, zero directions, means outside their supports, arbitrary latent sigma-fields, and proper face masses are handled without division by zero or a change of normalization. The predecessor symbols and exact attenuation aliases match the supplied facts; their symmetric-noise theorem is not applied to nonsymmetric noise. No mathematical error or proof gap was found.
